title: Control Center
subtitle: Platform administration. Separate from every restaurant workspace — actions here are audited.

plansPage.title: Plans & pricing
plansPage.subtitle: Review subscription plans, features, pricing and limits. Edits on this page are a LOCAL PREVIEW in this browser tab: nothing is saved to the database, published to customers or sent to billing. Stripe is not connected.
plansPage.simBanner: Local preview only. Plan edits stay in this browser tab and are lost on reload: they are not saved, not published and not recorded in the audit log. Prices shown are placeholders; Stripe is not connected.
plansPage.comparisonHint: Side-by-side view of what each plan includes.
plansPage.historyHint: Edits made in this browser tab, with reason and status. They are not saved anywhere.
plansPage.historyEmpty: No local edits in this tab.
plansPage.author: Author
plansPage.editDescription: Edits are kept as a local draft in this tab. “Apply locally” only updates the preview here: nothing is saved, published or audited.
plansPage.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this change being made?
plansPage.draftBanner: This plan has local draft edits in this tab only. They are not saved anywhere.
plansPage.confirmPublishBody: This only updates the preview in this browser tab. Nothing is saved to the database, published to customers, sent to billing or recorded in the audit log.
plansPage.confirmDeactivateBody: Local preview only: the plan stays available to subscribers. Nothing is saved or published.
plansPage.confirmActivateBody: Local preview only. Nothing is saved or published.
plansPage.impactHint: Estimated effect on existing customers. This is a simulation — no changes are applied.
plansPage.noImpact: No existing customers on this plan.

plansPage.publishedSuccess: Applied to the local preview only — nothing was saved or published.

plansPage.deactivated: Plan deactivated in the local preview only.
plansPage.existingWarning: Changes do NOT apply to existing subscribers without explicit authorization.

suspend.reactivateDescription: Restores normal operation for this organization. Recorded in the audit log.

sec.confirm: New accounts must confirm their email before signing in.
sec.noAutoAdmin: Platform roles are never granted at sign-up; the first-admin setup is one-time and audited.
sec.isolation: Organization data is readable only by its members. Platform admins receive no tenant access.
sec.storeScope: Managers and staff see only the stores they are assigned to.
sec.auditImmutable: The audit log cannot be edited or deleted by any app user.
sec.reasons: Every platform change requires a written reason.
sec.lastOwner: The last owner and the last platform administrator cannot be removed.
sec.suspension: Suspended organizations and inactive subscriptions cannot make changes; past-due access follows the configured grace rules.

settings.monitoringHint: Technical telemetry and uptime with clear distinction between live production and synthetic metrics.
settings.authAuditHint: Supabase Auth readiness evaluation without artificial blocking barriers.

authAudit.statusOk: Fully operational with no real blocker detected on authentication provider.
authAudit.rls: Multi-tenant isolation enforced via Postgres Row Level Security policies.
authAudit.tokens: Session tokens and expiration cycle managed natively.

settings.authorizationNote: Connecting payments, email or other external services always requires your explicit authorization.

metricsList.billingHint: Catalog prices; billing provider not connected
